# Introduction to MR instrumentation {.unnumbered}

{{< include "includes/WIP-callout.qmd" >}}

---

We begin withn a broad overview of MR instrumentation.  We describe how the main magnetic field is created, and the importance of super conductivity.  We also introduce the basic units of magnetic fields.

Then the two types of coils, **RF coils and gradient coils**, are introduced.  The RF coils have an essential role in evoking and recording the signal. How this works will be a relatively early topic, when we get to the free induction decay experiment at the beginning of the next section, @sec-mr-signals.

The gradient coils have an essential role in image formation, which we will describe in great detail in later chapeters.

**Safety** is very important to all of us. The risks, and most importantly how to be safe, when working around the magnet is a primary concern of all imaging centers.  And all users at these centers!
